scope: Developer harness and preflight preparation only
reason: No dedicated Android device is attached. Actual device, source, provenance, idle, writer-stop and storage evidence is absent. Execution is not authorised.

build.sourceDigestMeaning: SHA256 of ordered frozen primitive contents plus ordered harness main-source contents plus harness Gradle contents; not Git/AAB/distribution provenance
build.result: BUILD SUCCESSFUL; final invocation 37s; no installation or execution
build.normalAndroidRunChecks: passed; normal app release build only, harness excluded

device.adbObservation: List of devices attached; no rows

preflight.budget: S + M + T + R; T=S; M=1MiB+8192*sourceCount+4*encodedPreparedManifestBytes+2*preflightInputBytes; R=max(64MiB,ceil(S/10)); checked arithmetic. Independent review must confirm M bounds actual evidence and manifests. Existing destination/partials deny a fresh trial.
preflight.freshness: Independent baseline validity at most one hour, checked against device UTC; each scan revalidates files. Timestamp is not proof a writer remains stopped; independent controller must maintain exclusion.

inputContract.root: Harness private files/trial-source; not com.rork.vinetrack storage
inputContract.destination: files/trial-destination; fresh only; sources are never moved
inputContract.template: docs/stage1c-preflight-input.template.json is intentionally incomplete and always NO_GO
inputContract.sourceAdmission: Known reviewed business paths AND exact independent closed file list, no symlinks or unknown empty directories. Every device root is separately catalogued; absent roots require evidence, not assumption. Credentials must not be staged even as exclusions.
inputContract.proofBoundary: Family labels and reviewer assertions are not automatic semantic/provenance proof. Reviewed, pinned evidence must include exact record identities, source digests, creation custody, all photo dependencies and raw idle/closed states. Missing review denies GO.

representativeDataRequired.condition: Stable synthetic unsynchronised Pin rows and explicit pending status, no in-progress request. Independent fixture provenance per operation because legacy generic queue has no actor field.

representativeDataRequired.source: vinetrack_pending_photos.xml / pending_photos_json, completed_photo_cache_json; files/pending_pin_photos and any referenced display cache
representativeDataRequired.condition: Real valid synthetic JPEGs, exact absolute localPath references resolved in the prepared sandbox, stable revisions and pending records. No capture/upload in flight.

representativeDataRequired.source: vinetrack_domain_cache.xml / trips_<vineyard>; ended snapshot and tank actual sources where present
representativeDataRequired.condition: Trip is_active=false, valid end_time; representative path_points; every tank session valid end_time, is_filling_tank=false, active_tank_number and filling_tank_number absent. No open actual/session or unfinished start-tank journal. Do not treat invalid timestamps as closed.

representativeDataRequired.source: vinetrack_domain_cache.xml / growth_<vineyard>; paired growth/Pin capture evidence where relevant
representativeDataRequired.condition: Saved stage_code/stage_label/observed_at, linked IDs, locations and photo dependencies; completed capture transaction. Persisted queued Growth work allowed, no capture in flight.

Saved synthetic visit/observations and photographs with captured-by provenance; completed capture obligations, inert queued operations/photos and complete referenced paths. Pending unsent is allowed; in-flight request is not.

representativeDataRequired.source: vinetrack_recovery_snapshots_v2.xml / snapshot_<vineyard>; vinetrack_pin_capture_evidence.xml plus existing AtomicFile sidecars
representativeDataRequired.condition: Exact original recovery bytes and all sidecars retained without AtomicFile.openRead, repository constructors or repairs; no unresolved claim. Recovery snapshot alone does not cover JPEGs.

next: Supply access to a dedicated synthetic Android device or independently collected developer preflight evidence. Pin and compile the intended-device preflight-only APK, verify actual package, then seek separate execution approval. No request to activate migration or alter sign-out is implied.
limitations: Harness compiles, but no Android runtime preflight or representative fixture staging has been performed.
This isolated sandbox trial is not normal app startup, production account isolation, cloud/D2D transport or live repository certification.
Frozen primitives use ordinary source streams, so source filesystem noatime is required before scanning; unavailable noatime policy is a specific NO_GO, not permission to change source metadata.
Stop and time-budget checks operate at file/publication boundaries; no claim of immediate interruption of a large read, fsync or copy.
APK identity above is the locked preparation artifact. Adding device/preflight pins changes APK bytes and requires a new exact recorded fingerprint, not reusing this checksum.
Sampled preflight PSS and elapsed time are not trial peak measurements; actual trial measurements and restart proof remain absent.
